remark: The trigger scenarios for the exceptions are: UnsupportedOperationException if the list does not support the add operation; ClassCastException if the element type is incompatible; NullPointerException if the element is null and the list does not allow nulls; IllegalArgumentException if some property of the element prevents addition.
